Name: Radhuni Turmeric (Holud) Powder 50 gm
LongDescription: Radhuni Turmeric Powder is a vibrant and aromatic spice made from carefully selected turmeric roots. It is a staple in South Asian cooking, valued for its distinct flavor, bright yellow color, and health benefits. The powder is finely ground to ensure smooth blending in all types of dishes.rnrnIngredients: Pure Turmeric Roots.rn rnMaking Process:rnSourcing: High-quality turmeric roots are selected from trusted farms.rnCleaning: The roots are thoroughly washed to remove any impurities.rnBoiling: The cleaned roots are boiled to soften them and enhance their flavor.rnDrying: The boiled roots are dried in hygienic conditions to ensure optimal texture and shelf life.rnGrinding: The dried roots are ground into a fine powder using advanced machinery to retain their natural oils and nutrients.rnPackaging: The turmeric powder is sealed in airtight packs to maintain freshness, color, and aroma.rnrnUses: Enhances the flavor and color of curries, stews, rice dishes, and soups. Essential in preparing marinades for meat, fish, and vegetables.
